gloss: to have a prospect; to take shape

definitions.gloss: to have a prospect; to be in sight; to take shape
definitions.explanation: A goal, solution, or plan starts to become achievable or visible. The outlook becomes clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}が{立|た}った。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}が{立|た}つだろう。
examples.english: A solution will likely take shape by next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}が{立|た}たない⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延期|えんき}する→延期する：02517_enkisuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since there's no prospect of securing funding, we decided to postpone the plan.

notes:
USAGE:
{目処|めど}が{立|た}つ is commonly used in business and project contexts. The negative form {目処|めど}が{立|た}たない (no prospect in sight) is equally common.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{目処|めど}→目処：07286_medo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to establish a target/prospect — transitive)
- ⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to have an outlook — similar meaning)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}が{立|た}つ (completion is in sight)
- ⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}が{立|た}つ (restoration prospects emerge)
- ⟦{退院|たいいん}→退院：02090_taiin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}が{立|た}つ (discharge from hospital is in sight)
